summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 Part-0 changes (banner removal, engagement nudge toggle-badge redesign, cookie-consent relocation). All 6 tests (A-F) PASSED. No regressions found. No console errors from the new components. Screenshots captured live at /app/test_reports/screenshots/iter_part0/.

TEST_A_old_banner_removed.evidence: document.body.innerText contains neither 'Connect your repo to unlock your free SEO fix' nor '500 of 500 founder spots'. Chat screenshot (b2_after_skip.jpg) shows a clean chat surface with no orange banner at the top.

TEST_B_toggle_badge_collapsed.evidence: data-testid='engagement-nudge-post_skip-badge' rendered at bounding box {x:20, y:846.75, w:129, h:33.25} on 1440x900 viewport — bottom-LEFT. Small pill with Sparkle icon + 'Connect repo' label. ORA GUIDE mascot (data-testid='ora-guide-mascot-root') at {x:1382, y:763, w:38, h:45} — bottom-RIGHT. Opposite corners, no overlap. Bubble (data-testid='engagement-nudge-post_skip-bubble') NOT in DOM by default.

TEST_C_toggle_expand_collapse.evidence: Click 1 → bubble appears with full text 'Connect your repo so ORA can actually ship fixes for you — not just chat about them.\nConnect\nDismiss', with data-testid engagement-nudge-post_skip-action AND -dismiss both present. Click 2 → bubble removed from DOM. Toggle behavior working.

TEST_D_cookie_relocation.evidence: (a) /login unauth: cookie-consent-banner visible. (b) Accept all → banner removed. (c) After login → dashboard: banner NOT present. (d) Navigate to /settings while logged in: banner NOT present. No z-index overlap with ORA GUIDE mascot (mutually exclusive by loggedIn check).

TEST_E_public_landing_still_shows_cookie.evidence: localStorage cleared + navigate to '/' (Landing, logged-out) → cookie-consent-banner IS visible (screenshot e_landing_cookie.jpg confirms). GDPR regression preserved.

TEST_F_post_scan_badge_sanity.evidence: Logged in as test@aurem.dev (has connected project). data-testid='engagement-nudge-post_scan-badge' NOT rendered — expected per credentials note (post_scan pending_nudge already fired, server-side show:false). Only 1 console error observed, and it is a 403 from an unrelated resource load, NOT from the EngagementNudge component. No component crash.

critical_code_review_comments: EngagementNudge.jsx: badge has a nested X inside a <button>; clicking the X calls e.stopPropagation and setEligible(false). Because it's a <span role='button'> inside the outer <button>, this is technically invalid HTML (button-in-button semantics via role). Functionally works but a11y validators will flag it. Minor — main agent can defer.

CookieConsentBanner.jsx: the loggedIn state is derived from `localStorage.aurem_token` and re-checked on location.pathname change + a storage event listener. This is fine for typical login flows, but if login sets the token via a same-tab code path that neither triggers a navigation nor a storage event, the banner could stay visible until the next route change. Not observed here (login always navigates to /dashboard), but worth noting.
